Name: Live Weight
Use: Controller direct float. Live cylinder gross weight. Display only.

Name: Tare Weight
Use: Controller direct float. Captured tare / cylinder tare. Display only.

Name: Net Weight
Use: Controller direct float. Main net filling weight. Display only.

Name: Target KG
Use: Controller direct float. Active target kg/weight after setup. Display only.

Name: Rate Per KG
Use: Controller direct float. Active price/rate per kg. Display only.

Name: Target Amount
Use: Controller direct float. Active target amount after setup. Display only.

Name: Current Amount
Use: Controller direct float. Current filling amount. Display only.

Name: Fill State
Use: Machine fill state. Use as header word lamp.

Name: Alarm Code
Use: Alarm code. Use as alarm word lamp.

Name: HMI Preset Tare Weight
Use: Preset tare value if firmware requires it. Usually 0 because Capture Tare command is preferred.

Name: HMI Preset Target KG
Use: Preset target kg/weight to write from HMI.

Name: HMI Preset Rate Per KG
Use: Preset price/rate per kg to write from HMI.

Name: HMI Preset Amount
Use: Preset target amount to write from HMI.

Name: UI Mode
Use: 0=By KG, 1=By Amount. Controlled by mode tab buttons.

Name: UI Desired KG
Use: Operator desired kg. Used in By KG mode; calculated in By Amount mode.

Name: UI Desired Amount
Use: Operator desired amount. Used in By Amount mode; calculated in By KG mode.

Name: UI Progress Percent
Use: Calculated progress percent for progress bar, 0..100.
